gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: Change in estimates of prior year provisions 1,824
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves amounting to $1.824 million in 2024, representing 41.09% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening is explicitly stated as a 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' in the technical provisions note. The report discusses general factors influencing reserve estimates, including actuarial and statistical projections, judgement regarding past claims development, claim inflation, public attitude to claiming, economic conditions, portfolio mix, policy conditions, claims handling procedures, interest rates, settlement delays, and foreign currency rates, but does not attribute the specific movement to any particular event or line of business.

Critical judgement is applied when estimating the value of amounts that should be provided for claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported (IBNR)
ultimate cost of outstanding claims is estimated using a range of techniques including actuarial and statistical projections, benchmarking, case by case review and judgement
past claims development experience can be used as a basis to project ultimate claims costs
Judgement is used to assess the extent to which past trends may not apply in the future

The Directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them. However, ultimate liability will vary as a result of subsequent information and events and this may result in significant adjustments to the amounts provided.
